extraction.Name: Carl Joseph Brown
extraction.Refused/Protested: he was issued a forced patent in fee to his 160 acre allotment...but he refused to accept it; that it was sent to his parents after he got over to France; that, when he got back, he finally accepted it
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: he has never paid any taxes on this allotment, never mortgaged or sold it
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: he has never paid any taxes on this allotment
extraction.Occupation/Income: he farms this allotment for his living, that being his only income
extraction.NOTES: mentally competent, has fine health; has a wife and two children to support, the family having good health; allotment described as SE, Sec. 33, T.37N., R.36W., of the 6th P.M., in South Dakota, 160 acres; deponent joined the United States Army on May 24, 1918, and served in France; no one has ever disputed his possession of this piece of land; has never received any aid from the County, State nor the United States Government; never sold his allotment for any debts incurred prior to receiving the patent in fee; affidavit subscribed and sworn April 22, 1929, Shannon County, South Dakota | ORIGINAL_TRIBE_VALUE: "Pine Ridge Agency" (normalized 2026-04-28 to canonical 'Pine Ridge')

recovery_notes.rationale: Pine Ridge tribe field had 40+ string variants across the corpus. Consolidating to canonical 'Pine Ridge' for clean tabulation while preserving original variant in NOTES for audit.
